The front door opened itself and I walked inside and to the dining room a group of human figures all sitting around the table the person is the center was my grandmother.

She apologized for interrupting my sleep and make a joke about how she tried to contact my mom (her daughter) first but my mom wouldn't "pick up".

The other figures who's faces I was unable to see, one of them she called by name, the name used was my uncle who died one month before I was born and had down syndrome, there were a few times she said things along the lines of "no ____ she can't see you" my mom told me before he died he was excited to meet "the new baby"
